'''Mezenti Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Located near [[Deucalon Spaceport]] and the [[Promenade]], the spaceport was predominantly used by individuals affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Location" /> The spaceport was owned by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Godoba]] the Shrewd.<ref name="A Crushing Blow">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|A Crushing Blow|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>
